Record Class SpinOffHistoryBasisDecider.Input

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.instrument.SpinOffHistoryBasisDecider.Input
Record Components:
spinOff - the spin-off with its current history basis
connector - the parent's current history connector
urlExtend - the parent's current history URL extension
historySourceIsSplitSource - true when history connector and URL equal split connector and URL
storedUnadjusted - true when the stored quotes before the action date are unadjusted for it
storedLoadedBeforeAction - true when the parent's last full load is dated before the action date
sameDaySplitFactor - product of the factors of the parent's stored splits dated on the action date
stored - the stored quotes of the window
delivered - the delivered quotes of the window, before any revert
Enclosing class:
SpinOffHistoryBasisDecider
